PR Summary by Qodo

Add an edit command for open todo items ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add todo edit ID TEXT to replace an open item’s text without changing its other fields.
>• Reject done or unknown items, and validate IDs and text before loading the file.
>• Cover successful edits, error precedence, unchanged files, and subprocess behavior with tests.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD CLI["edit ID TEXT"] --> Validate["Check ID/text"] --> Load["Load list"] --> Find["Find item"] --> Done{"Item done?"} -->|No| Save["Save and confirm"] Validate -->|Invalid| Error["Error exit"] Load -->|Read failure| Error Find -->|Missing| Error Done -->|Yes| Error ```
High-Level Assessment

>The localized command handler is appropriate: it reuses existing validation, lookup, and atomic store operations. A generic mutation framework would add complexity without a clear benefit for this command.
Files changed (5) +269 / -1

Enhancement (1) +45 / -1
cli.pyImplement the edit command +45/-1
>Implement the edit command > >
>• Registers 'edit ID TEXT' and replaces only the text of a found, open item before saving. Reuses ID and text checks before loading, handles dash-led IDs as bad IDs in supported argument forms, and reports done-item errors through the existing CLI error path.
>
> >todo/cli.py
Tests (1) +172 / -0
test_cli.pyTest edit behavior and failure paths +172/-0
>Test edit behavior and failure paths > >
>• Adds CLI and subprocess tests for text replacement, preservation of other fields, and rejection of done or missing items. Tests also cover malformed arguments, validation before file loading, failed writes, non-UTF-8 text, and byte-identical files after rejected edits.
>
> >tests/test_cli.py
Documentation (3) +52 / -0
DISPOSITIONS.mdRecord no cold-review findings +3/-0
>Record no cold-review findings > >
>• Adds the M5 disposition ledger, indicating that no findings required disposition.
>
> >reviews/cold/M5/DISPOSITIONS.md
round-1.mdDocument the first edit-command review +21/-0
>Document the first edit-command review > >
>• Records the first review’s criteria, test evidence, scope, and absence of findings. It describes the command before the later done-item restriction.
>
> >reviews/cold/M5/round-1.md
round-2.mdDocument the done-item follow-up review +28/-0
>Document the done-item follow-up review > >
>• Records evidence for refusing edits to done items alongside the earlier edit criteria. It reports no findings in the second review.
>
> >reviews/cold/M5/round-2.md

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
